protocol.pipeline: Official SGM corpus (11,034 items) ingested into an isolated local vault with zero LLM calls and zero vector embeddings. Retrieval uses our deterministic Adaptive Self-Information Ranking engine (0-Vector, 0-LLM, no SQLite FTS5, no rank-index RRF). The official homogeneous 8B protocol is used: the top-10 ranked items are rendered with the exact official MMRag item text formats and injected into the exact official MMRAG SYSTEM and USER_TEXT prompts.
protocol.index_time_note: Shared engine ingest measured on the 11,034-item corpus (0.004 hr); the Qwen answer run reuses the same ingest path.
protocol.reproduction_cli: rmem eval --suite atm --tier {hard,1013} --answerer llm --judge off --raw-limit 10 --workers 2 --eval-base-url http://127.0.0.1:18080/v1 --eval-model Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct (local llama.cpp); the judge pass uses dev/scripts/atm_official_rejudge.py with gpt-5-mini (reasoning minimal) and the pinned official LLM_JUDGE_PROMPT.

main_token_usage.cached_prompt_note: Local llama.cpp run; no KV-cache credit is claimed. Prompt tokens are a re-tokenization of exactly the published delivered evidence with the same Qwen tokenizer.
main_token_usage.judge_usage_note: Same instrumented judge pass that produced the published verdicts (per-call request/response/usage logs published).
